handlers.name: bk
handlers.body:
function bk takes unit Bk,integer ck returns integer
local integer KO=0
local integer vI=0
loop
if(GetItemTypeId(UnitItemInSlot(Bk,KO))==ck)then
set vI=vI+1
endif
set KO=KO+1
exitwhen KO>=5
endloop
return vI
endfunction

handlers.name: Ck
handlers.body:
function Ck takes unit Bk,integer ck,integer dk returns nothing
local integer KO=0
local integer vI=0
local integer rc=0
loop
if(GetItemTypeId(UnitItemInSlot(Bk,KO))==ck)then
call RemoveItem(UnitRemoveItemFromSlot(Bk,KO))
if(rc==0)then
call UnitAddItemById(Bk,dk)
endif
set rc=rc+1
endif
set KO=KO+1
exitwhen KO>=5
endloop
endfunction

handlers.name: Dk
handlers.body:
function Dk takes nothing returns nothing
local integer MI
local unit u=GetTriggerUnit()
local player p=GetOwningPlayer(u)
local item it=GetManipulatedItem()
local integer yR=GetItemTypeId(it)
if(yR=='I004')then
if(Zr)then
set MI=GetPlayerId(p)
set Wi[MI]=Wi[MI]+($5DC)
call AdjustPlayerStateBJ(1,p,PLAYER_STATE_RESOURCE_FOOD_CAP)
else
call AdjustPlayerStateBJ($5DC,p,PLAYER_STATE_RESOURCE_GOLD)
call DisplayTextToPlayer(p,.0,.0,"|cffFF0000You can't increase your Legendaries limit! No Legendaries is activated!|r")
endif
elseif(yR=='I008')then
set MI=GetPlayerId(p)
set Wi[MI]=Wi[MI]+(600)
set u=CreateUnitAtLoc(p,'e008',jr,.0)
call UnitAddAbility(u,'A06D')
call UnitApplyTimedLife(u,'BTLF',29.)
elseif(yR=='I007')then
set MI=GetPlayerId(p)
set Wi[MI]=Wi[MI]+($578)
set u=CreateUnitAtLoc(p,'e008',jr,.0)
call UnitAddAbility(u,'A06C')
call UnitApplyTimedLife(u,'BTLF',29.)
elseif(yR=='I001')then
set MI=GetPlayerId(p)
set Wi[MI]=Wi[MI]+($96)
if(bk(u,'I001')==4)then
call Ck(u,'I001','I002')
endif
elseif(yR=='I005')then
set MI=GetPlayerId(p)
set Wi[MI]=Wi[MI]+($96)
elseif(yR=='I003')then
set MI=GetPlayerId(p)
set Wi[MI]=Wi[MI]+(650)
elseif(yR=='I00A')then
set MI=GetPlayerId(p)
set Wi[MI]=Wi[MI]+(600)
elseif(yR=='I009')then
set MI=GetPlayerId(p)
set Wi[MI]=Wi[MI]+(500)
elseif(yR=='I006')then
if(Dr>=$F)then
set MI=GetPlayerId(p)
set Wi[MI]=Wi[MI]+(550)
else
call RemoveItem(it)
call AdjustPlayerStateBJ(550,p,PLAYER_STATE_RESOURCE_GOLD)
call DisplayTextToPlayer(p,.0,.0,"|cffFF0000Orb of Lightning can be obtained only after 15 minutes of the game!|r")
endif
elseif(yR=='I000')then
call DR(p)
call RemoveItem(it)
call DestroyEffect(AddSpecialEffectTarget("Abilities\\Spells\\Other\\Transmute\\PileofGold.mdl",u,"origin"))
call Nk(GetPlayerId(p))
endif
set it=null
set u=null
endfunction

handlers.name: qk
handlers.body:
function qk takes unit u,real tx,real ty returns nothing
local unit c=CreateUnit(GetOwningPlayer(u),'e008',tx,ty,.0)
call UnitAddAbility(c,'A02G')
call IssueImmediateOrderById(c,$D012D)
call UnitApplyTimedLife(c,'BTLF',1.)
set c=null
endfunction

handlers.name: Qk
handlers.body:
function Qk takes unit u,integer sk returns nothing
local player p=GetOwningPlayer(u)
if(sk==0)then
set sk='I008'
elseif(sk==1)then
set sk='I007'
elseif(sk==2)then
set sk='I006'
elseif(sk==3)then
set sk='I003'
elseif(sk==4)then
set sk='I004'
elseif(sk==5)then
set sk='I005'
elseif(sk==6)then
set sk='I00A'
elseif(sk==7)then
set sk='I001'
elseif(sk==8)then
set sk='I009'
endif
call IssueNeutralImmediateOrderById(p,oa[ea[GetPlayerId(p)]],sk)
endfunction

handlers.name: Sk
handlers.body:
function Sk takes nothing returns nothing
local unit u=GetTriggerUnit()
local integer tk=GetSpellAbilityId()
if(IsUnitType(u,UNIT_TYPE_STRUCTURE))then
if(tk=='A09A')then
call yC(u,(Gv[GetUnitPointValue((u))]))
elseif(tk=='A0EK')then
call ab(u,GetSpellTargetUnit())
else
call VI(u)
endif
elseif(tk=='A005')then
call pk(u,GetSpellTargetX(),GetSpellTargetY())
elseif(tk=='A08Y')then
call qk(u,GetSpellTargetX(),GetSpellTargetY())
elseif(tk>='IBA0' and tk<='IBA8')then
call Qk(u,tk-'IBA0')
else
call OI(u,tk,GetSpellTargetUnit())
endif
set u=null
endfunction
